transparency.description: The transparency effect of the image. The value should be in the interval [0.0, 1.0], where 0 means no effect and 1 means completely transparent.

brightness.description: The brightness effect of the image. The value should be in the interval [-1.0, 1.0], where 0 means no effect.

contrast.description: The contrast effect of the image. The value should be in the interval [-1.0, 1.0], where 0 means no effect.
